entries.title: Genesis 10:1
segments: ¶Now this [is] the genealogy of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And sons were born to them after the flood.

entries.title: Genesis 10:2
segments: The sons of Japheth [were] Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

entries.title: Genesis 10:3
segments: The sons of Gomer [were] Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

entries.title: Genesis 10:4
segments: The sons of Javan [were] Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

entries.title: Genesis 10:5
segments: From these the coastland [peoples] of the Gentiles were separated into their lands, everyone according to his language, according to their families, into their nations.

entries.title: Genesis 10:6
segments: ¶The sons of Ham [were] Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 10:7
segments: The sons of Cush [were] Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabtechah; and the sons of Raamah [were] Sheba and Dedan.

entries.title: Genesis 10:8
segments: Cush begot Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one on the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 10:9
segments: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; therefore it is said, "Like Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD."

entries.title: Genesis 10:10
segments: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

entries.title: Genesis 10:11
segments: From that land he went to Assyria and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

entries.title: Genesis 10:12
segments: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah (that [is] the principal city).

entries.title: Genesis 10:13
segments: Mizraim begot Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

entries.title: Genesis 10:14
segments: Pathrusim, and Casluhim (from whom came the Philistines and Caphtorim).

entries.title: Genesis 10:15
segments: ¶Canaan begot Sidon his firstborn, and Heth;

entries.title: Genesis 10:16
segments: the Jebusite, the Amorite, and the Girgashite;

entries.title: Genesis 10:17
segments: the Hivite, the Arkite, and the Sinite;

entries.title: Genesis 10:18
segments: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were dispersed.

entries.title: Genesis 10:19
segments: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon as you go toward Gerar, as far as Gaza; then as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.

entries.title: Genesis 10:20
segments: These [were] the sons of Ham, according to their families, according to their languages, in their lands [and] in their nations.

entries.title: Genesis 10:21
segments: ¶And [children] were born also to Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder.

entries.title: Genesis 10:22
segments: The sons of Shem [were] Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.

entries.title: Genesis 10:23
segments: The sons of Aram [were] Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

entries.title: Genesis 10:24
segments: Arphaxad begot Salah, and Salah begot Eber.

entries.title: Genesis 10:25
segments: To Eber were born two sons: the name of one [was] Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother's name [was] Joktan.

entries.title: Genesis 10:26
segments: Joktan begot Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

entries.title: Genesis 10:27
segments: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

entries.title: Genesis 10:28
segments: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

entries.title: Genesis 10:29
segments: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these [were] the sons of Joktan.

entries.title: Genesis 10:30
segments: And their dwelling place was from Mesha as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

entries.title: Genesis 10:31
segments: These [were] the sons of Shem, according to their families, according to their languages, in their lands, according to their nations.

entries.title: Genesis 10:32
segments: These [were] the families of the sons of Noah, according to their generations, in their nations; and from these the nations were divided on the earth after the flood.
